props.name: preset
props.label: preset

props.name: title
props.label: title
props.description:
Primary heading. Rendered as a `<h2>`-equivalent element with
the chosen `size`. Override entirely via the `#title` slot when
richer markup is needed (a link, an icon-prefix, …).

props.name: description
props.label: description
props.description:
Optional sub-heading rendered below the title. Multiple lines
supported; the SCSS layer clamps the readable width via the
`--origam-empty-state---max-width` token.

props.name: icon
props.label: icon
props.description: Override the preset icon. Accepts the same `TIcon` shape as ``: a MDI / iconify string, an array of SVG path tuples, or a Vue `Component`. Use the `#icon` slot for full SVG / `` illustrations.

props.name: iconColor
props.label: iconColor
props.description:
Override the preset's icon color (the semantic intent that maps
to `--origam-color__action--{intent}---bg` /
`--origam-color__feedback--{intent}---bg`).

props.name: size
props.label: size
props.description:
Vertical density. Drives icon size, title / description font
sizes, padding and gap.

props.name: align
props.label: align
props.description:
Horizontal alignment of the icon / title / description / actions
stack.

props.name: fontFamily
props.label: fontFamily
props.description:
Font family token. Maps to `--origam-font__family---{fontFamily}`
(sans · mono · serif).
When unset, the component keeps its theme font-family.

props.name: fontSize
props.label: fontSize
props.description:
Font size token. Maps to `--origam-font__size---{fontSize}`
(xs · sm · md · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · 4xl · 5xl).
When unset, the component keeps its theme / density font-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.label: fontWeight
props.description:
Font weight token. Maps to `--origam-font__weight---{fontWeight}`
(regular 400 · medium 500 · semibold 600 · bold 700 · extrabold 800 · black 900).
When unset, the component keeps its theme font-weight.

props.name: lineHeight
props.label: lineHeight
props.description:
Line-height token. Maps to `--origam-font__lineHeight---{lineHeight}`
(none 1 · tight 1.25 · snug 1.375 · normal 1.5 · relaxed 1.625 · loose 2).
When unset, the component keeps its theme line-height.

slots.name: default
slots.label: default
slots.description:
Replaces the entire built-in layout (icon + title + description
+ actions). Use this for a fully bespoke layout — e.g. a hero
empty page with a custom illustration and a multi-column CTA
grid.

slots.name: icon
slots.label: icon
slots.description: Replaces the default `` rendering. Use for SVG / `` illustrations. Mark the surface `aria-hidden="true"` when it is purely decorative.

slots.name: title
slots.label: title
slots.description:
Replaces the rendered title element. Slot wins over the `title`
prop when both are provided.

slots.name: description
slots.label: description
slots.description:
Replaces the rendered description element. Slot wins over the
`description` prop when both are provided.

slots.name: actions
slots.label: actions
slots.description:
Actions row rendered below the description (or the title when
`description` is absent). Typically holds 1–2 buttons (Create,
Retry, Switch to offline mode, Sign in).
